post.description: Accept an OTLP/HTTP protobuf trace batch for the authenticated project. The key requires traces_write scope. Batches are limited to one MiB after decompression and 256 spans, with at most 32 allowlisted attributes per span and 60 batches per minute per key. Identity and gzip encodings are supported. Failures contain a protobuf google.rpc.Status. Content, events, links and unknown fields are discarded. Run and attempt correlations are retained only when owned by the authenticated principal.

429.description: The trace or caller rate limit is exceeded

503.description: Trace storage or limits are unavailable

post.summary: Send a message to or read, cancel, and subscribe to a task from a published A2A agent
post.description: Supports A2A 0.3 and 1.0 JSON-RPC send, streaming send, task read, cancellation, and subscription methods. The published protocol determines the accepted methods and response format. Requires the agents scope and an explicit allowlist entry. OLP task IDs are bound to the initiating key and project, and OAuth tasks also to the caller's grant identity. Streaming methods return events as they arrive, with a one MiB maximum per event. For each outbound agent send, OLP supplies an olpt_ capability in the X-OLP-Task-Capability request header to the remote agent. The agent can present it as a bearer token on supported model and MCP callbacks. Callback attempts count toward the task limit and are accounted separately from the remote agent fee. Disconnecting does not immediately cancel the upstream task. Disconnected tasks remain subject to deadline and authorization checks; OLP requests cancellation when those checks fail but cannot guarantee that a remote agent stops.

parameters.name: A2A-Version
parameters.description: Selects the published agent or pinned task protocol. Header and query values must agree when both are present. Omission selects A2A 0.3 for legacy clients.

post.summary: Delegate a key to an authenticated workload agent
post.description: Exchange an authenticated agent assertion and exactly one delegating API key or member consent code for a one-use inference token. Both principals, the consent and every requested route must authorize the request.

parameters.description: The API key that owns the delegated inference and has the delegate scope.

parameters.name: X-OLP-Delegation-Consent
parameters.description: A one-use member consent code bound to the authenticated agent, key, project, routes and expiry. Provide either this header or X-OLP-Delegating-Key.

parameters.description: The current workload assertion is required when Authorization contains a one-use delegation token.

BearerAuth.description: Use an API key, a one-use delegation token, or an olpt_ task capability as a bearer token. Task capabilities apply only to chat completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages, Gemini generation and MCP tool calls, within the original task owner’s current authority, pinned resources and task lifetime. Delegated inference also requires the current workload assertion in X-OLP-Agent-Identity.

GatewayExecutionCapability.description: Caller-specific gateway tool execution capability. Omitted when the route does not offer gateway execution to this caller. This describes configured rights and certification, not a live quota reservation or a guarantee of a successful run.

enabled.description: Whether at least one enabled route target has tool-call certification for a mode on this model discovery surface.

default_toolsets_allowed.description: Whether all default route toolsets can be resolved together for the caller. A request can select a permitted subset with olp_toolsets.

limits.description: Effective configured route and caller limits, including defaults. Request limits can only narrow these bounds.

certified_modes.description: Modes with at least one enabled target certified for tool calls on the discovery surface. Target selection and admission are still evaluated for each request.

tools.description: Tools from published route toolsets that the caller may resolve. Toolsets the caller cannot resolve are omitted.

alias.description: Name exposed to the model during gateway execution.

classification.description: Operator classification. An unclassified tool is reported as approval_required.

unit_price.description: Pinned price per dispatched call in the installation pricing currency. Null means unpriced, while zero means free.

WorkflowApprovalSubmission.description: After obtaining a human's approval, resubmit the original transcript and tool arguments. The token expires within five minutes and can be used only once.

approved.description: The client must explicitly set this to true after obtaining human approval.

arguments.description: The original JSON arguments indexed by the paused call ID.

WorkflowApprovalPause.description: The workflow paused before an approval-required tool. The client obtains human approval and resubmits the original transcript and arguments.

ChatToolsetSelection.description: Select a subset of the published toolsets allowed by the route. An empty array selects no toolsets.

PublishedPromptReference.description: Specify exactly one published label or immutable revision ID.

params.description: Parameters for the selected A2A version and method. Task references must use an OLP task ID; push notifications and tenant selection are not supported.

result.description: A task or message result in the published A2A version with OLP task IDs.

url.description: Preferred JSON-RPC endpoint for A2A 0.3 clients

security.description: Bearer authentication requirements for A2A 0.3 clients

ttl_seconds.description: Grant lifetime in seconds. Omit or use 0 for the 300-second default. Principal expiry can shorten the lifetime.

delegation_pair_digest.description: Stable pair budget ID for this delegation.

id.description: Project-owned prompt publication ID prefixed with olpp_

ResponsesPublishedPromptReference.description: A registry prompt has an olpp_ ID and exactly one label or revision ID. Other prompt IDs retain the provider contract.
